example: The library is one block from the station.
example_translation: 图书馆距车站一个街区。
note: 本批为城市街区，不是阻挡这一动词义

example: The test tube contained a small sample of blood.
example_translation: 试管里装着少量血液样本。

example: She wore a cotton blouse to the exhibition.
example_translation: 她穿着一件棉质女式衬衫去看展览。

example: A cold wind began to blow across the lake.
example_translation: 一阵寒风开始吹过湖面。
note: 本例为风吹，不是名词打击

example: A blue ribbon marked the path through the trees.
example_translation: 一条蓝色丝带标出了林间小路。
note: 本批为颜色义，不是忧郁义

example: They used a long board to cover the gap.
example_translation: 他们用一块长木板盖住了缝隙。
note: 本批为木板，不是登车登船

example: The boat drifted slowly towards the shore.
example_translation: 小船缓缓向岸边漂去。

example: The diver kept her body straight as she entered the water.
example_translation: 那位跳水者入水时保持身体笔直。

example: The water began to boil in the kettle.
example_translation: 壶里的水开始沸腾。

example: Workers found an unexploded bomb near the old bridge.
example_translation: 工人在那座旧桥附近发现了一枚未爆炸的炸弹。

example: Shared experiences created a strong bond between the two friends.
example_translation: 共同的经历在两位朋友之间建立了牢固的纽带。
note: 本批为关系义，不是债券义

example: The museum displayed the bone of a large ancient animal.
example_translation: 博物馆展出了一块大型古代动物的骨头。

example: The company gave each worker a small bonus.
example_translation: 公司给每位员工发了一笔小额奖金。

example: She left the book open on the desk.
example_translation: 她把书摊开放在书桌上。
note: 本批为名词，不是预订义

example: The new railway may boost trade between the towns.
example_translation: 新铁路可能会促进这些城镇之间的贸易。

example: His left boot was covered in mud.
example_translation: 他的左靴上沾满了泥。

example: The river forms the border between the two regions.
example_translation: 这条河构成了两个地区之间的边界。

example: The children grew bored during the long wait.
example_translation: 漫长的等待使孩子们感到无聊。
note: 描述感受的人，区别于 boring 令人无聊的

example: The lecture was boring because it repeated the same point.
example_translation: 那场讲座反复讲同一个观点，令人感到乏味。
note: 描述使人无聊的事物，区别于 bored

example: She was born in a village beside the river.
example_translation: 她出生在河边的一个村庄。
note: 过去分词，常用 be born；不把 bear 或 bore 当作本词的拼写变体

example: May I borrow your map for a moment?
example_translation: 我能借用一下你的地图吗？
note: 从别人处借入用 borrow，借给别人用 lend

example: Her boss asked her to organise the exhibition.
example_translation: 她的上司请她组织展览。

example: The botanical garden grows plants from several continents.
example_translation: 这座植物园种植着来自几个大洲的植物。

example: Both doors were locked when we arrived.
example_translation: 我们到达时，两扇门都锁着。
note: 本批为限定词，后接复数名词

example: I did not want to bother her while she was working.
example_translation: 她工作时，我不想打扰她。

example: He filled the bottle with fresh water.
example_translation: 他把瓶子装满了清水。

example: A layer of sand covered the bottom of the jar.
example_translation: 罐子底部铺着一层沙。

example: The rubber ball can bounce higher than the wooden one.
example_translation: 橡胶球能比木球弹得更高。

example: The weather is bound to change before evening.
example_translation: 傍晚之前，天气一定会变化。
note: be bound to do sth；不与 bind 的拼写互换

example: A stone wall marks the boundary of the garden.
example_translation: 一道石墙标出了花园的边界。

example: The actors bow together at the end of the play.
example_translation: 演出结束时，演员们一起鞠躬。
note: 本义读 /baʊ/，不是弓或蝴蝶结的 /bəʊ/

example: She poured the soup into a large bowl.
example_translation: 她把汤倒进一个大碗。

example: We went bowling after the final lesson.
example_translation: 最后一节课结束后，我们去打了保龄球。

example: The letters were kept in a wooden box.
example_translation: 那些信件存放在一个木盒里。

example: She watches boxing but prefers to practise swimming.
example_translation: 她看拳击比赛，但更喜欢练习游泳。

example: The boy waited beside the fountain with his dog.
example_translation: 那个男孩带着狗在喷泉旁等候。

example: The brain processes information from our senses.
example_translation: 大脑处理来自感官的信息。
note: 本批为器官，不是聪明才智这一引申义

example: A bird landed on a low branch of the oak tree.
example_translation: 一只鸟落在橡树的一根低枝上。
note: 本批为树的枝条，不是分支机构

example: This brand makes waterproof bags for walkers.
example_translation: 这个品牌为徒步者生产防水包。
note: 本批为商品品牌，不是烙印义

example: The brave traveller crossed the bridge despite her fear.
example_translation: 那位勇敢的旅人虽然害怕，还是过了桥。
note: 勇敢不表示完全没有恐惧

example: The bakery sells fresh bread every morning.
example_translation: 面包店每天早晨出售新鲜面包。
note: 通常不可数；一片用 a slice of bread

example: Be careful not to break the glass bowl.
example_translation: 小心不要打碎那个玻璃碗。

example: We ate breakfast before setting out for the hills.
example_translation: 出发去山里之前，我们吃了早餐。

example: The robin has a bright red breast.
example_translation: 那只知更鸟的胸脯呈鲜艳的红色。
note: 本例为鸟的胸部，不是乳房义

example: He took a deep breath before opening the letter.
example_translation: 打开信之前，他深吸了一口气。
note: 名词 breath，区别于动词 breathe

example: She paused to breathe before climbing the next hill.
example_translation: 攀登下一座山前，她停下来喘了口气。
note: 动词词尾 /ð/，不是 breath 的 /θ/

example: One loose brick fell from the old wall.
example_translation: 一块松动的砖从旧墙上掉了下来。

example: A narrow bridge connects the two sides of the village.
example_translation: 一座窄桥连接着村庄的两边。

example: The guide gave us a brief explanation of the route.
example_translation: 导游向我们简要说明了路线。
note: 本批为形容词，不是摘要这一名词义

example: A bright lamp hung above the desk.
example_translation: 书桌上方悬着一盏明亮的灯。
note: 本批为光线明亮，不是聪明义

example: The team found a brilliant solution to the problem.
example_translation: 团队找到了一个解决问题的绝妙办法。
note: 本批为出色义，不是发亮义

example: Please bring a torch for the evening walk.
example_translation: 傍晚散步时，请带一支手电筒来。
note: bring 指朝说话者或指定地点带来

example: A broad river separated the two towns.
example_translation: 一条宽阔的河流隔开了这两座小镇。
note: 本批为宽度义，不是广泛的这一引申义

example: The station will broadcast the interview tomorrow.
example_translation: 那家广播电台明天将播出这次采访。

example: The brochure includes a map of the castle.
example_translation: 那本小册子里有一张城堡地图。
note: 常指介绍或宣传用的小册子

example: My younger brother helped me carry the tent.
example_translation: 弟弟帮我搬了帐篷。
note: 英语需用 younger 或 older 区分弟弟与哥哥

example: The brown leaves covered the garden path.
example_translation: 褐色的树叶覆盖了花园小路。

example: Use a soft brush to clean the frame.
example_translation: 用一把软刷子清洁画框。
note: 本批为工具名词，不是刷这一动词义

example: We need to keep the repairs within our budget.
example_translation: 我们需要把维修费用控制在预算之内。

example: The hotel serves a buffet at lunchtime.
example_translation: 酒店在午餐时段供应自助餐。
note: 名词读音与表示连续击打的动词不同

example: A bug caused the programme to close unexpectedly.
example_translation: 一个程序错误导致软件意外关闭。
note: 本批为计算机语境，不是虫子义

example: They plan to build a footbridge across the stream.
example_translation: 他们计划在小溪上建一座人行桥。

example: The oldest building in the village is a small chapel.
example_translation: 村里最古老的建筑是一座小礼拜堂。
note: 本批为名词，不是 build 的进行式

example: Older students must not bully younger children.
example_translation: 年长的学生不得欺负年幼的孩子。

example: She bought a bunch of grapes for the picnic.
example_translation: 她为野餐买了一串葡萄。

example: Dry branches burn quickly.
example_translation: 干树枝燃烧得很快。

example: The balloon may burst if we add more air.
example_translation: 如果再充气，气球可能会爆裂。
note: burst 的过去式和过去分词仍为 burst

example: The squirrel will bury the nuts near the tree.
example_translation: 松鼠会把坚果埋在树旁。
note: 本批为埋藏物品，不是安葬人

example: The last bus leaves the square at ten.
example_translation: 末班公共汽车十点离开广场。
note: 乘公共汽车通常说 by bus

example: She started a small business selling handmade cards.
example_translation: 她开始经营出售手工卡片的小生意。

example: The bakery is especially busy before the festival.
example_translation: 节日前，面包店格外忙碌。

example: The journey was long, but the scenery was beautiful.
example_translation: 旅程很长，但沿途风景很美。

example: The butcher cut the meat into smaller pieces.
example_translation: 肉贩把肉切成了更小的块。

example: Spread a little butter on the warm bread.
example_translation: 在温热的面包上抹一点黄油。
note: 不可数名词，不与 cream 奶油混淆

example: A butterfly settled on the purple flower.
example_translation: 一只蝴蝶落在紫色的花朵上。

example: Press the green button to start the recording.
example_translation: 按绿色按钮开始录音。
note: 本批为设备按钮，不是衣服纽扣

example: We can buy tickets at the museum entrance.
example_translation: 我们可以在博物馆入口买票。

example: We travelled to the coast by train.
example_translation: 我们乘火车去了海边。

example: She cut the cabbage into thin strips.
example_translation: 她把卷心菜切成了细条。

example: The cafeteria serves hot meals until two.
example_translation: 自助食堂供应热餐，直到两点。
note: 通常指餐食自取的食堂

example: The empty cage stood in a corner of the room.
example_translation: 那个空笼子放在房间的角落里。

example: She decorated the cake with small paper flags.
example_translation: 她用小纸旗装饰蛋糕。
note: 本例中的 cake 是一整个蛋糕

example: We need to calculate the distance before we choose a route.
example_translation: 选择路线之前，我们需要计算距离。

example: Mark the workshop date on your calendar.
example_translation: 在日历上标出工作坊的日期。

example: I will call the hotel to check our reservation.
example_translation: 我会打电话给酒店核实预订。
note: 本批为电话联系，直接接联系对象

example: She practises calligraphy with a brush every morning.
example_translation: 她每天早晨用毛笔练习书法。

example: The sea was calm at sunrise.
example_translation: 日出时海面很平静。

example: The label shows the calorie content of each serving.
example_translation: 标签标出了每份食物的热量。
note: 本例不涉及不同热量单位的数值换算

example: A camel carried supplies across the sandy plain.
example_translation: 一头骆驼驮着物资穿过沙地平原。

example: She put the camera away when the rain began.
example_translation: 开始下雨时，她收起了照相机。

example: We reached the camp just before sunset.
example_translation: 我们在日落前抵达营地。
note: 本批为名词，不是露营这一动词义

example: The students organised a campaign to reduce plastic waste.
example_translation: 学生们组织了一项减少塑料垃圾的活动。
note: 本批为有目标的活动，不是军事战役

example: The library stands at the northern end of the campus.
example_translation: 图书馆位于校园北端。

example: Can you open the window for me?
example_translation: 你能帮我打开窗户吗？
note: 情态动词后接动词原形；列强读，句中也可弱读

example: The boat moved slowly along the canal.
example_translation: 小船沿着运河缓缓前进。
note: 本批为人工水道，不是人体管道义

example: They had to cancel the picnic because of heavy rain.
example_translation: 由于大雨，他们不得不取消野餐。

example: The laboratory studies how cancer cells grow.
example_translation: 实验室研究癌细胞如何生长。
note: 本批为疾病名称，不采用比喻义

example: Each candidate will have a short interview.
example_translation: 每位候选人都将接受一次简短面试。

example: A candle lit the small room.
example_translation: 一支蜡烛照亮了那个小房间。

example: He offered each child a piece of candy.
example_translation: 他给每个孩子一块糖。
